_comment: What each gate must have looked at before it may say 'pass' -- read by
scripts/gate_scope.py (a Python port of gnomon's scripts/gate_scope.mjs).
known_gaps: today's REAL gaps in the identity checks, each named, so the gate
passes today and fails on any NEW gap. The lists only shrink: an entry that is
no longer a gap fails the gate until it is removed, and an entry added since
the merge base with main fails unless the commit says `Ratchet-Exempt: <why>`.
Every item here is a thing nothing in backend/tests/ touches directly.
floors: smoke alarms for scope collapse, set well BELOW today's counts so
ordinary work never trips them and a broken selector always does. A floor is
the weaker instrument -- it cannot see a partial miss -- which is why the
Measured 2026-09-19 at a61112a: backend 560 tests in 33 files, frontend 47
tests in 5 files, ruff over 103 files, mypy over 59, tsc over 46; skills 4/10
imported by a test, MCP tools 7/7 referenced, state-changing routes 5/11

backend-tests.why: The full backend suite (560 on 2026-09-19). The unit+guardian subset alone is 482, so a run that silently lost the integration suite lands under 500.

frontend-tests.why: The vitest suite (47 on 2026-09-19). vitest-files is the identity check per file; this catches the run collapsing outright.

backend-ruff-files.why: Python files ruff inspected under backend/ (103). Under 90 means the selector in scripts/lint-baseline.json stopped meaning all of backend/.

backend-mypy-files.why: Source files mypy --strict checked under backend/src (59). Under 50 means a package fell out of the check, which would lower the error count for the wrong reason.

frontend-tsc-files.why: Project (non-node_modules) files in the tsc program (46). Under 35 means tsconfig's include stopped reaching src/.

skills-imported.why: Skill modules no test imports. They run only transitively (MCP wrappers, agents), so no test pins their own contract. Each leaves this list when a test imports it -- ideally one asserting its output against a known ground truth.

mcp-tools.why: None today: all 7 registered tools are referenced (tests/unit/test_mcp_tools.py calls each wrapper; tests/integration/test_mcp_stdio.py calls each over stdio).

routes-tested.why: State-changing routes no test calls, over HTTP or by handler. /approve left this list on 2026-09-21 with backend/tests/integration/test_governance_approval_flow.py; /reject is still untested and still ignores the verdict it is handed.

routes-mounted.why: None today: every state-changing handler decorated in backend/src/api/ is mounted on the app.

pytest-files.why: None today: every backend/tests/**/test_*.py reports at least one test.

vitest-files.why: None today: every frontend/src test file reports at least one test.
